title: The Hallway Track: What Even Is Harness Engineering
description:
Simon Maple hits the hallway track at AI Engineer in San Francisco (with a brief cameo from Sunny the puppy) to find out what everyone's actually talking about — starting with the phrase of the week: harness engineering.

In this episode: why loop engineering is the real unlock — agents that keep working without asking for your input every few operations — how models have fundamentally changed their approach to long-running tasks, why feedback loops and updatable memory matter, and one speaker's self-healing Pokémon harness fine-tuned on an open-weight model (don't try this at home — very expensive). Plus: Sonnet 5 dropped mid-conference.

Subscribe for more from the AI Native Dev at AI Engineer SF.
